summary: Automate GitHub Release creation (notes + simple assets) + guarded hard-reset (opt-in --apply) inside `gh plate release finalize`. Core helpers added for reusability (workflow slice #593 will call them). Idempotent create, dry-run first-class, existence guards before reset.
migration_impact: Downstream PLATE repos running `gh plate release finalize` after a Release PR merge will now automatically populate the GitHub Releases tab (latest + notes) instead of requiring manual gh release create. --apply is required for the destructive reset step (still prints the command and errors clearly if guards fail). Add the new fragment on cut.
migration_guidance: After upgrading, re-run `gh plate release finalize <last-ver>` with --apply if you want the branch reset (otherwise just the release object will be created).
The vX.Y.Z/assets/ convention is new and optional for attaching extra release artifacts.
Update any local scripts that parsed the old 'Recommended commands' output from finalize.
Status (sibling #594) will soon surface GitHub release state to detect/create success.
agent_notes: This closes the main automation gap from #591 (post #569 MVP). The helpers are designed to be called from release.yml too. Use --apply deliberately. Tests cover dry, exists, assets convention, guard messages. See #592 body for full ACs and planning decisions (both create+reset automated, workflow auto in follow-up, explicit simple assets).
